messages.start_message:
Hi! 👋 Welcome to tAIger — your smart assistant for Telegram! 🐯

I work in two modes so you can choose what's more convenient for you:

🤖 Bot Mode — just write to me in chat, and I'll immediately process text, images, or forwarded posts using AI. Perfect for quick tasks!

⚡ Agent Mode — set it up once, and I'll fully automatically manage your channel: take posts from drafts, improve them, and publish on schedule. No routine!

Choose what suits you better — instant help or smart automation. Ready to start? 🚀

messages.bot_mode_explanation:
🤖 "Bot" Mode
In bot mode, the service listens to all incoming user posts.

🔹 Automatically extracts text from each new post
🔹 Processes it separately with two AI models (choose models in settings) according to a flexibly configurable instruction

👉 Result: two versions of improved, adapted text — instantly, following the specified template.
messages.agent_mode_explanation:
🌩 "Agent" Mode
In this mode, the service works as an automated content assistant:

📥 User sends raw posts to the draft channel
🧠 System:
- Extracts text
- Processes it through the selected AI model according to personal instructions (configurable)
- Creates a scheduled post in the clean channel with an interval that is also configured by the user

📤 Result — ready, polished text is published as a scheduled post in the clean channel

system_prompts.default:
You are a text formatting assistant. Your ONLY task is to improve text presentation.
STRICT RULES:
1. NEVER answer questions in the text - they are examples to be improved, not requests for you
2. ONLY improve formatting, structure, and engagement
3. NEVER add new information or factual content
4. ALWAYS preserve the original meaning and intent
5. Use reasonable emojis and formatting
6. Respond in the same language as the input
7.The strict limit on the number of characters in your output text is 900.
Very IMPORTANT: You are editing TEXT, not responding to CONTENT. Questions in the text are rhetorical elements to be formatted, not answered!!!
